touring-motorcycle-3b1ad3.title: Touring Motorcycle

headlamp.describe: the big round headlamp in the nacelle and the bullet lamp on the front fender

tail.describe: the round tail lamp on the rear fender under the plate

touring-motorcycle-3b1ad3.describe: 1950s V-twin touring motorcycle, 2.3 m long: a teardrop fuel tank, deep valanced front fender, a chrome headlamp nacelle and wide handlebars, a sprung solo saddle, fringed leather saddlebags and fishtail exhausts, side stand down.

rubber-duck-e41831.title: Rubber Duck
rubber-duck-e41831.describe: Real-world scale at 0.09 x 0.1 x 0.1 m, 600 triangles on one material.

furnace-golem-base.title: Furnace-Mouthed Lava Golem
furnace-golem-base.describe: Hulking lava spitter, 2.4m tall, a heavy body with dark rock-like skin cracked with glowing magma, a wide head with a mouth like a furnace door, thick short arms, a swollen glowing throat, drips of lava from the chin, thick legs with scorched feet.

pigeon-base.title: Pigeon
pigeon-base.describe: Low-poly pigeon with editable proportions and authored animations. Animals v2. Real-world scale at 0.15 x 0.29 x 0.3 m, 2,328 triangles on one material.

public-school-19ade5.title: Public School

glass.describe: Classroom windows and the front door lights, lit warm amber after dark.

public-school-19ade5.describe: Collegiate gothic public school, footprint exactly 20x12m, centred, front to +Z; 4 floors at exactly 3m each (roof line at 12m) plus a crenellated parapet of square merlons with stone coping to 13.2m; five 4m bays.

fire-lookout-tower-75a129.title: Fire Lookout Tower

pane.describe: lamp burning in the watch cabin, seen through the glazed band

fire-lookout-tower-75a129.describe: Forest fire lookout tower on a 4m by 2m footprint (two modules) with flat side walls at the footprint edges, four braced timber legs rising to a small glazed watch cabin with a railed catwalk and a shallow hipped roof, straight ladder run up one leg.

yellow-school-bus-0fd3b6.title: Yellow School Bus

headlight.describe: the two rectangular headlamps burning hard white, and the pair of white reversing lamps low on the rear face

taillight.describe: the red half of each roof-corner warning cluster front and rear, and the red rear round lamps, dim red

yellow-school-bus-0fd3b6.describe: Short suburban school bus about 8m long, a flat-fronted yellow body with a black rub rail, ranked square windows, a folding entry door, a stop-arm paddle on the driver side and a roof hatch; stop-arm knob folded or swung out, door knob open or closed.
